title: Playing a five minute captioned recording never holds the app over 50 ms
goal: The video focus promises that on a five minute recording with its captions written, no frame of playback keeps the app busy for more than 50 ms, so a click or key during playback answers at once. Nothing has ever measured that while the video plays. Measure it, fix any frame that holds the app longer, and keep a walk that turns red if it ever comes back.
notes: Third success item of video-beats-premiere in queue/objectives.json. Open thread in the manager reports of 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16. Checked 2026-10-19: a-long-captioned-recording-walk.json measures the longest pass after key presses (longestUnderMS 80, lines 22-42) and after captions land (150, line 14) but never plays; a-captioned-recording-sits-quiet-walk measures idle busy time (busyUnderMS 400). The step is PlaytestStep.wait(seconds:onTheClock:longestUnderMS:busyUnderMS:) (PhotonzCore/PlaytestScript.swift:2713-2723). Frame lateness while playing is already guarded by playing-a-recording-never-blinks-walk (done tasks a-full-screen-retina-recording-keeps-up-while-it, a-full-screen-recording-keeps-up-as-it-plays-acr); this task is about the main thread, not frame supply.
acceptance: Measured first at Next defaults, no flags changed: open the five minute captioned talk that a-long-captioned-recording-walk uses, write its captions with Add Captions, play 20 seconds from the start and 20 seconds across a cut; the longest single main thread pass and how many passes went over 50 ms go in this task's log

The walk harness measures main thread passes while the video plays (the clock wait with longestUnderMS may already do it; add what is missing), and a-long-captioned-recording-walk or a new walk in the rotating set fails when any pass during playback goes over 50 ms
If today's numbers fail, the cause is fixed and the before and after numbers are in the audit; if they already pass, the walk is the deliverable and the audit says so plainly
playing-a-recording-never-blinks-walk and an-editing-session-walk stay green; Scripts/test.sh passes; a perf note in the commit if the render path changes
